androidResizeComparison.method: Rebuilt and installed with baseline StreamTextView.kt and StreamTextLineHeightSpan.kt. Other feature files retained; plain paths of prepared layout are unchanged. This isolates the renderer changes, not a full clean baseline checkout. Feature sources/APK restored afterward.
androidResizeComparison.result: Both plain resize tests reproduce the same failure. At 300 dp root width, 239.2381 dp bubble changes from canvas/old height to textView/new height.
androidResizeComparison.knownLimitation: syncCanvas(false) posts settleCanvas on a width-cache miss. No new plain resize behavior is introduced by rich-block rendering; the existing two checks remain red.
